ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure is a schematic outline map of China, and uses gray patches together with the legend "wasteland" to indicate the distribution of China's "three great wastelands," among which the southern low-latitude region corresponds to the "Southern Great Wasteland" in the question stem. Then reason: the question stem says that the northern boundary of rubber planting expanded from 17°N to 24°N, meaning that rubber can be planted in areas with higher latitude and relatively poorer heat conditions. Rubber is a tropical crop that likes high temperature and fears cold; the natural latitude and heat conditions have not fundamentally changed, so being able to break through the original northern planting boundary mainly relies on advances in agricultural technology such as new-variety breeding, cultivation management, and cold protection. Therefore the main reason is the development of agricultural technology.
